why: Default hosts that do not resolve today, in servers that are NOT deprecated because their other host (production) exists. Each is waiting on a decision: fixing the host alone would not make the server work, because the provider's documented API also differs in auth or paths. check-catalog-hosts.py fails if an entry's host comes back to life or leaves the source, so this list cannot go stale silently. Measured 2026-09-27.

Caixa's sandbox is a path on the production host (api.caixa.gov.br:8443/sandbox/...) with login on logindes.caixa.gov.br
no Itau-hosted doc names a sandbox API host; production tokens come from sts.itau.com.br
Bradesco's API docs are behind a login; no public source names the homologation host
Izipay documents sandbox-api-pw.izipay.pe with tokens at /security/v1/Token/Generate, not /auth/login
